parts.html: The K-14 model is a straight beige minimalist kitchen with an island, for apartments and houses where the kitchen is open to the living room.
The fronts are solid-colored, without a pattern, so all you see are the lines of the cabinets and the island.
The cabinets and built-in appliances run along the wall, and the island adds a second work surface, which makes it easier for two people to cook together.
The total length is 7.6 linear meters, with enough room for both the cabinets and the work zones.
The fronts are mixed: acrylic-faced MDF on top and HPL-faced MDF below. Different materials, one color.
Hardware: FREE FOLD Hafele lift-up mechanisms on the wall cabinets, Muller Profi Line soft-close hinges, and Muller Box Profi Line drawers.
Upper cabinet fronts: Acrylic-faced MDF board
Lower cabinet fronts: HPL-faced MDF board
Drawer system: Muller Box Profi Line
We change the island size and the arrangement of the K-14 cabinets and work surfaces to fit your room.
